messages:
Aisha (CS): quick debrief from pilot kickoff with Veloria. They like throughput but surfaced 3 items that could affect renewal if left open. dropping raw notes.
Ben (CSM): summary: finance wants per-campaign cost splits, ops hit duplicate downstream writes from client retries, product asked for clearer per-route latency slices. risk = medium.
Aisha (CS): customer asks (verbatim):
- exportable per-campaign cost attribution (header or metadata)
- optional server-side webhook retry with idempotency tokens + DLQ
- per-route latency percentiles (p50/p95) surfaced in console or CSV
Aisha (CS): their eng lead pasted a curl they used when duplicates happened: `curl -H "X-Campaign: veloria-q2" -H "X-Idempotency: abc-123" -d '{"route":"score","id":42}' https://hooks.veloria.io/ingest`
Jun (Eng): quick take: campaign-tag export is low effort (header passthrough + usage export change) ~1 sprint. per-route p50/p95 reuses metrics pipeline ~1 sprint. server-side retries + idempotency + DLQ is bigger work, roughly 2-3 sprints for minimal safe implementation.
Rae (PM): propose prioritization: (1) campaign export MVP, (2) per-route percentiles, (3) retries/idempotency. which do we want to commit to this sprint?
Ben (CSM): CFO asked specifically for a CSV they can use in reconciliation by EOW. if we can promise campaign export this sprint that's the fastest way to reduce renewal risk.
Aisha (CS): action: I'll open a feature ticket with acceptance criteria and attach sample CSV rows + logs. will ask customer to confirm header name (they prefer `X-Campaign`).
SupportBot: created ticket RW-7458 "campaign-cost-export MVP" assigned to Product; link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-7458 :white_check_mark:
Jun (Eng): I'll add a short tech note in RW-7458 about header passthrough and CSV mapping. will also draft constraints for idempotency header format and DLQ semantics in a follow-up ticket.
Rae (PM): Jun, can you post the idempotency note by Thu so we can scope the retries work?
Ben (CSM): I'll set customer expectation: campaign export first, then follow-up on retries timeline. Aisha please ping when ticket is ready so I can loop in CFO.
Aisha (CS): will do. closing loop until ticket grooming. thanks team :)
